title: ShortNCopy
description: A full-stack URL shortener built for speed and zero friction - no sign-up required. Users generate and share shortened links instantly, with a Next.js frontend, Express/MongoDB backend, and TanStack Query handling data fetching, all written in TypeScript for type safety end to end.

title: Movie Recommender
description: Developed a movie recommendation system using Python that suggests movies based on user preferences and similarity algorithms.

title: Code Reviewer
description: Built an AI-powered code review tool using Gemini API that analyzes code, provides feedback, and suggests improvements for better code quality.

title: Aniwatch-Figma Prototype
description: Designed a modern anime streaming app prototype in Figma, focusing on intuitive UI/UX, responsive layout, and smooth user flow.

title: Quizzy
description: Developed an interactive quiz game using Next.js with dynamic questions, score tracking, and responsive UI for engaging user experience.

title: MERN Authentication System
description: A secure and scalable MERN authentication system with login, registration, email verification, password reset, and Google OAuth. Uses JWT, Zustand, and bcrypt for modern authentication and state management.
